repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate computes an absolute difference (using `if (diff < 0) { diff = t1 - t2 }`) before checking the threshold, whereas the IR specifies a signed difference (`$t2 - $t1`). This causes the JoI to trigger on temperature drops (negative change) when the IR only triggers on rises (positive change >= 3). Evidence F2 confirms an extra action was emitted at 1200000ms when the IR emitted none.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute-value logic. The script now directly computes `t2 - t1` and checks if it is `>= 3`, matching the IR's signed arithmetic and trigger condition exactly.
